function _checkSession(address key, address target, bytes calldata data) private view { if (!isValidSessionKey(key)) revert NotAuthorised(); if (target == address(this)) revert ForbiddenTarget(); bytes4 selector; if (data.length != 0) { if (data.length < 4) revert InvalidCalldata(); selector = bytes4(data[:4]); if (selector == bytes4(0) || _isBlockedSelector(selector)) revert ForbiddenCall(selector); } if (_permAt[_permKey(key, target, selector)] != _sessionVersion[key]) revert CallNotAllowed(target, selector); }
